title: Should You Take Reservations or Stay Walk-In Only?

scenes.say: Should you take reservations, or stay walk-in only?
Reservations help you plan staff and food for the night. Walk-in only keeps things simple, with no no-shows to chase.

left.name: Maria
left.label: Reservations
left.note: staff and prep for the night

scenes.speaker: Maria
scenes.say: I book for a Friday dinner. For a coffee, I just walk in.

props.name: Maria
props.quote: Friday dinner? I *book*. Coffee? I walk in.

scenes.say: So most places can mix both. Take bookings for big tables and busy nights. Keep some tables for walk-ins. And a quick cafe can stay walk-in.
